pricing.title: Five levels. One system that grows with your business.
pricing.sub: Senior nearshore delivery priced below typical local full-service agencies in our target markets. Every package includes the previous one; all prices are total project prices in USD.
pricing.r1i: One page with up to 7 sections, custom design, phone and tablet adaptation, contact form, phone and WhatsApp buttons, map and basic SEO setup.
pricing.r2i: Everything in START, expanded to a maximum of 8 pages. Scroll animations, gallery, services, blog and an admin panel for editing the text, photos and content defined in the project.
pricing.r3i: Everything in BUSINESS, plus online bookings, availability calendar, services and specialists, bookings with or without an account, customer account, email confirmations and booking administration.
pricing.r4i: Everything in BOOKING, plus a basic custom CRM: customer records, history, sales stages, tasks, employee roles, simple reports and export. AI chat based on company information, with transfer to a human operator.
pricing.r5i: Everything in CRM & AI, plus an iOS and Android app built from a shared codebase: customer account, bookings, history, push notifications and AI chat. Website and CRM sync, employee calendar and app-store publishing preparation.
pricing.r5note: From USD 29,900. This package is fully tailored; the final price varies with workflows, integrations, data migration, compliance and launch markets.
pricing.includedText: English delivery, discovery, custom design, two design revision rounds, responsive implementation, QA, launch, admin training and 30 days of defect support against the agreed scope.
pricing.separateText: Domain, hosting, third-party subscriptions, AI usage, SMS, paid assets and Apple or Google publishing accounts. Ongoing maintenance is quoted separately.
pricing.individualText: E-commerce, payments, ERP or accounting integrations, regulated data, complex migration, multiple brands or branches and enterprise workflows.
pricing.vat: Applicable sales tax, GST or VAT is added according to the client location and invoice rules.
pricing.note: The proposal confirms scope, milestones and a fixed project price. Payments are staged against delivery milestones.

faq.title: The questions business owners ask us
faq.q1: How much does a website or a CRM cost at wtech.md?
faq.a1: International WTECH packages start at USD 1,490 for START, USD 3,490 for BUSINESS, USD 6,900 for BOOKING, USD 14,900 for CRM & AI and USD 29,900 for COMPLETE. Each package includes the previous one; applicable tax is added separately.
faq.a2: A presentation website takes 3 to 5 weeks. A custom CRM takes 6 to 10 weeks. An AI employee can be answering clients within 2 weeks. We work in two-week sprints and you see the result after every sprint.
faq.a3: You do. All code, design and data are yours from the first payment. You receive them in a private repository and can move them anywhere, any time.
faq.q4: Where is the website or CRM hosted?
faq.a4: On Vercel, AWS, Azure, Google Cloud, your own infrastructure or another provider agreed in the proposal. We keep the application portable and hand over the code and deployment documentation.
faq.q5: Do you work with international teams?
faq.a5: Yes. Delivery, documentation and project management are available in English, with planned overlap for North American, European and Australian working hours.
faq.a6: You get 30 days of support included. After that you can choose a monthly maintenance plan or call us when you need something. We do not lock you in.
faq.q7: Do you work with small businesses?
faq.a7: Yes. The packages are designed for small and mid-sized companies that need a serious website or operating system without large-agency overhead.
faq.q8: Can you integrate 1C, accounting, Amazon or Facebook Leads?
faq.a8: Yes. We integrate 1C and 1C accounting, Facebook and Instagram Lead Ads, Gmail and Google Workspace, WhatsApp Business, Telegram, Viber, maib, MICB, PayNet and MPay, plus Amazon and marketplaces through their APIs. If it has an API, we connect it.
faq.a1_short: You receive a written project price after the discovery call. The five international packages are priced in USD.
